activity.notes: Al-Walid I, son of Abd al-Malik, was Umayyad caliph from 705 to 715. His reign coincided with the caliphate's major expansion into Transoxiana, Sind and al-Andalus. ATLAS uses the secure year-level reign because medieval sources preserve differing exact death dates.

sources.title: Ruling Dynasties of Iran — The Oxford Handbook of Iranian History
sources.citation_text: The Oxford Handbook chronology lists Al-Walid I as Umayyad caliph from 705 to 715.

sources.title: Al-Walid I — Treccani Dizionario di Storia
sources.citation_text: Treccani identifies al-Walid I as Marwanid Umayyad caliph and dates his reign to 705–715.
